version.changes: First version, from the Notion draft

blocks.text: The Partner Packs Portal is where our clients' employees book AIM courses using their company's Partner Pack, where client admins manage their people and contracts, and where Scentia staff look after it all.
You know our clients and how they work. We want to know two things:

items: **Is the portal easy to use?** Could you work out what to do without help?
**Would it work for our clients?** Does it match how we want them to book, approve and manage training?

blocks.text: You can't break anything. This is a test copy with made-up clients, people and courses. No real emails go to clients, and no real payments are taken.

items: **Kickoff meeting:** Thursday 19th November, 16:00

**Feedback goes to: “**Partner Packs Portal UAT” Teams chat. Ez reads every message, may reply with questions, and turns each one into a task for the developers. We'll tell you when something you raised has been fixed, so you can check it.

blocks.text: There are 25 journeys, grouped by who you're testing as: an employee, a client admin, or Scentia staff. Work through as many as you can during the week, in any order. The journeys are a starting point, not a limit: you're welcome to explore anything else too (see "Exploring on your own" in section 5).

items: The clients, people and courses are all made up, e.g. Delta Air Group, Boronia Builders and Harbour Health.
Dates are real dates, counted from when the test data was set up. Sessions get closer as the week goes on.
**Emails aren't part of this round.** While you're masquerading, emails go to the made-up person, so you won't see them. If a screen says an email has been sent, take its word for it.
No real payments are taken.
All testers are using the same clients at the same time, so if something isn't as a journey describes, another tester may have changed it. Mention it in the Teams chat rather than waiting.
If you can't sign in, or you're stuck, post in the Teams chat.
Go to [partnerpacks-uat.aim.com.au](https://partnerpacks-uat.aim.com.au).
Enter your Scentia email address. We'll email you a sign-in link and a code.
Click the link, or type the code into **Sign-in code**.

blocks.text: You'll land on the **Clients** page. This is the Scentia staff view. To test as a client admin or an employee, use Masquerade (next section).

sections.title: Masquerade: testing as a client admin or employee

blocks.text: Masquerade lets you use the portal as if you were someone else, such as a client admin or an employee, so you see exactly what they see. It only exists on the test portal and will never be on the real one.

items: Sign in with your own Scentia account.
Click **Masquerade** in the top menu.
Under "Who do you want to masquerade as?", type part of the person's name or email in **Search by name or email**, then click **Search**.
Find the person in the list. It shows their role and company, e.g. "Client admin, Delta Air Group", and whether they've signed in before. Click **Masquerade** next to them.
You're now in the portal as them. A bar across the top says **You're masquerading as** and their name.

blocks.text: Click **End masquerade** in the bar. You'll be back on the Masquerade page as yourself, ready to pick someone else.

items: Everything you do is real for that person: bookings, approvals and seats used. It's all recorded under your name, so we can always see who did what.
You can't masquerade as another Scentia staff member, or as someone who has no access right now. They'll show in the list without a Masquerade button, with the reason.
If you're idle for 30 minutes, you'll be signed out and need to start again.
To switch people, end the masquerade first, then pick the next person.

blocks.text: **Each journey tells you who to be.** It names the person and their company, e.g. "**Be:** Kai Okafor, Delta Air Group". Type their name into **Search by name or email**, e.g. `Kai Okafor`, and check the company in the results matches before you click Masquerade. A couple of names appear at more than one company.
**To see everyone at a company,** search for the company part of their email, e.g. `deltaair`, `banksiabank` or `harbourhealth`. You'll get a list of that company's people, with each person's role.
**To find people from the client's own pages,** go to **Clients**, open the client, then:

items: **Overview** lists the client's admins, and which one is the primary admin.
**Employees and bookings** lists the people who have booked.
**Access lists** shows who's on each contract's allow list.

blocks.text: Note the name, then go to **Masquerade** and search for it.

**Some journeys ask you to make up a person,** e.g. `yourname.test@banksiabank.example`. Type the whole email into the search. If the client lets anyone with that email domain book, the portal finds them even though they don't exist yet, and you can masquerade as them.

**If someone shows in the results without a Masquerade button,** the reason is shown beside them. For example, they're Scentia staff, or nothing lets them in right now. That's expected for some journeys, e.g. UJ-3 before the client goes live.

Read the goal and do it however seems natural. Don't look for instructions first, because how easy it is to work out is part of what we're testing. When you're done, go through the checklist. If something on it didn't happen or you couldn't find it, send it as feedback.

items: Go with your first reaction. If something made you hesitate, that's worth telling us, even if you worked it out.
Try to do it yourself before asking for help. If you're stuck for more than a couple of minutes, that's feedback in itself.

blocks.text: You don't have to stick to the journeys or the people they name. If you want to try something else, go for it.

items: **You can masquerade as anyone** in the test data. See "Who to masquerade as" in section 4 for how to find them.
**Put things back** if you change a setting, such as an approval setting, an allow list or a client's domains, so the other testers aren't caught out.
**Don't set up Southern Rail, Wattle Energy or the third new client outside UJ-3.** Each can only be taken live once, and they're saved for UJ-3.
**Don't remove a client's original email domain.** It would stop everyone at that client signing in.

blocks.text: When you send feedback from exploring, write "Exploring" as the journey and describe what you were trying to do.

subsections.title: What we want to hear about

items: **Confusing:** you weren't sure what to click, what a word meant, or what would happen next.
**Doesn't fit our clients:** "Clients would never do it this way", or "a client will definitely ask for X and it isn't here."
**Something went wrong:** an error, or a number that looks wrong.
**Wording:** a label or message that's unclear, too long, or doesn't sound like us.
**What works well:** tell us this too, so we don't change it.

blocks.text: Post one message per issue in the Teams chat, using this template:

**Journey:** e.g. "Exploring", or UJ-1, Asking for a place and getting it approved
**I was testing as:** Scentia staff / client admin / employee (and who you masqueraded as)
**What I was trying to do:**
**What happened:**
**What I expected, or what would be better:**
**How much does it matter?** Stops me / Annoying / Small thing
**Screenshot:** attach a screenshot if possible

Each journey starts with **goals**. Do them your own way, then go through **Then check**. Masquerade as the person named: search for their name, and check the company matches (see "Who to masquerade as" in section 4). Where there's a choice of people, pick one the other testers aren't using and say which in the Teams chat, so you don't trip over each other.
